title: SkillBrowser: Selective Skill Exposure for Scalable Skill-Using Agents

paragraphs.en: Large language model agents increasingly rely on reusable skills to extend their capabilities in complex tasks. However, scalable skill use requires Selective Skill Exposure : providing relevant procedural content when needed while avoiding unnecessary exposure that may disrupt reasoning. Existing paradigms fall short in complementary ways. Progressive disclosure exposes metadata for a growing skill library, introducing context pollution; retrieval limits catalog exposure, but static retrieval from the initial task query may be misaligned with capability needs that emerge during reasoning and may still inject unnecessary skills. We propose SkillBrowser , a Meta-Skill-managed framework that enables an agent to identify current capability needs, formulate targeted queries, and selectively load skills on demand. Across six SRA-Bench subsets and five LLMs, SkillBrowser improves aggregate accuracy over static retrieval and LLM-based selection, including multi-step tool use, and mitigates accuracy degradation on already-solvable instances. Benefits remain model- and task-dependent, with under-invocation of useful skills and additional latency as key limitations. These results demonstrate the viability of Meta-Skill-managed access for scalable skill repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型智能体越来越依赖可重用的技能，以在复杂任务中扩展其能力。 然而，可扩展的技能使用需要选择性技能暴露：在需要时提供相关流程内容，同时避免可能干扰推理的不必要暴露。 现有范式在互补性方面存在不足。 渐进式披露会暴露不断增长的技能库中的元数据，从而引入上下文污染；检索限制则限制了目录的暴露范围，但基于初始任务查询的静态检索可能与推理过程中出现的能力需求不匹配，并且仍可能引入不必要的技能。 我们提出了 SkillBrowser——一个由元技能管理的框架，使智能体能够识别当前的能力需求、制定针对性查询，并根据需求选择性加载技能。 在六个 SRA-Bench 子集和五个大型语言模型上，SkillBrowser 相较于静态检索和基于大型语言模型的筛选方法，提升了综合准确率（包括多步骤工具使用），并减轻了原本可解决实例中的准确率下降问题。 其效果仍因模型和任务而异，关键局限性在于有用技能调用不足以及额外延迟。 这些结果表明，由元技能管理的访问方式在可扩展的技能存储库中具有可行性。

paragraphs.en: Large language models have rapidly evolved from passive text generators into agentic systems capable of planning, tool invocation, environmental interaction, and iterative problem solving. As LLM-based agents are applied to increasingly open-ended and long-horizon tasks, they must draw on external reusable capabilities beyond their static parametric knowledge. Such modularity enables agents to reuse procedural knowledge and interact with task-specific resources in a structured manner.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型已从被动的文本生成器迅速演变为具备规划、工具调用、环境交互和迭代问题求解能力的智能体系统。 随着基于大型语言模型的智能体被应用于日益开放且长期导向的任务，它们必须利用超越静态参数知识的可复用外部能力。 这种模块化设计使智能体能够以结构化的方式复用程序性知识，并与任务特定的资源进行交互。

paragraphs.en: Skills extend LLM agents with reusable task-specific capabilities: each Skill contains procedural instructions and may include auxiliary resources such as scripts or references ( Xu and Yan, 2026 ) . Unlike callable tools, loaded Skills contribute instructions directly to the agent’s working context and can therefore influence its subsequent reasoning ( Li et al., 2026b ; Han et al., 2026 ) . This property raises a central scalability problem, which we term Selective Skill Exposure (SSE): a scalable Skill system should expose the procedural support needed for solving a task while avoiding unnecessary Skill information that may disrupt the agent’s reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 技能为 LLM 智能体提供了可重复使用的特定任务能力：每个技能都包含流程化指令，并可能包括脚本或参考资料等辅助资源（Xu 和 Yan，2026）。 与可调用工具不同，已加载的技能会直接将指令注入智能体的工作语境中，因此能够影响其后续推理过程（Li 等人，2026b；Han 等人，2026）。 这一特性引出了一个核心的可扩展性问题，我们将其称为“选择性技能暴露”（Selective Skill Exposure，SSE）：一个可扩展的技能系统应当提供完成任务所需的过程化支持，同时避免引入可能干扰智能体推理的冗余技能信息。

paragraphs.en: Existing paradigms fall short of SSE in complementary ways. Recent Skill-compatible agents commonly adopt progressive disclosure, exposing lightweight metadata, typically Skill names and descriptions, before loading detailed instructions and resources on demand ( Xu and Yan, 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) . Although this avoids preloading every full Skill, its globally exposed metadata still grows with the repository, consuming context budget, introducing semantic noise, and preventing the agent from accessing the required Skill ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . As illustrated in Figure 1 (a), metadata exposure alone may exhaust the available context before the Gold Skill is loaded.
paragraphs.zh: 现有范式在互补的方面上未能达到 SSE 的要求。 近期与技能兼容的智能体通常采用渐进式披露方法，在按需加载详细指令和资源之前，先暴露轻量级元数据（通常是技能名称和描述）（Xu and Yan, 2026；Jiang et al., 2026）。 尽管这种方法避免了预加载所有完整的技能，但其全局暴露的元数据仍会随着知识库的扩大而增加，从而消耗上下文预算、引入语义噪声，并阻碍智能体访问所需的技能（Zheng et al., 2026）。 如图 1 (a) 所示，仅暴露元数据就可能在加载黄金技能之前耗尽可用的上下文空间。

sents.zh: 如图 1 (a) 所示，仅暴露元数据就可能在加载黄金技能之前耗尽可用的上下文空间。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval provides a natural alternative by selecting a small subset of Skills from an external repository ( Su et al., 2026 ; Cho et al., 2026 ; Lumer et al., 2025 ) . However, static Skill retrieval addresses exposure size rather than SSE itself. First, retrieving from the initial user request may be misaligned with the procedural capability required during solving: as shown in Figure 1 (b), that capability may be obscured by a noisy request or emerge only after reasoning begins. Second, once retrieved, Skill contents are injected irrespective of whether external procedural assistance is necessary. Because Skills alter the reasoning context, such blind injection may interfere with tasks that the agent could otherwise solve correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 检索方法通过从外部存储库中选择少量技能（Skills），提供了一种自然的替代方案（Su et al., 2026；Cho et al., 2026；Lumer et al., 2025）。 然而，静态的技能检索针对的是暴露规模，而非 SSE 本身。 首先，根据初始用户请求进行检索可能与问题解决过程中所需的过程性能力不匹配：如图 1(b) 所示，这种能力可能被噪声较多的请求所掩盖，或者仅在推理开始后才会显现。 其次，一旦技能被检索出来，无论是否需要外部的过程性帮助，其内容都会被注入。 由于技能会改变推理上下文，这种盲目的注入可能会干扰智能体原本能够正确完成的任务。

paragraphs.en: To address this problem, we propose SkillBrowser , a Meta-Skill-managed framework for selective Skill exposure over large Skill repositories. Rather than globally exposing Skill metadata or unconditionally injecting statically retrieved Skills, SkillBrowser equips the agent with a reusable Meta-Skill that governs access to the repository during reasoning. The agent can identify its current capability need, generate a targeted query, retrieve relevant Skills through SkillGrep , and load selected Skill contents only on demand, as illustrated in Figure 1 (c). This design changes repository access from passive exposure to agent-controlled acquisition: repository scale is decoupled from the context visible to the agent, while unnecessary procedural content need not enter an already successful reasoning process.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 SkillBrowser——一个由元技能管理的框架，用于在大型技能库中选择性地暴露技能。 SkillBrowser 并未全局暴露技能元数据或无条件注入静态检索的技能，而是为智能体配备了一个可重用的元技能，该元技能在推理过程中控制对技能库的访问。 如图 1(c) 所示，智能体能够识别当前的能力需求，生成针对性查询，通过 SkillGrep 检索相关技能，并仅在需要时加载选定的技能内容。 这种设计将技能库的访问方式从被动暴露转变为由智能体控制的主动获取：技能库的规模与智能体可见的上下文解耦，同时不必要的流程性内容无需进入已经成功的推理过程。

paragraphs.en: We formulate Selective Skill Exposure as a central problem in scaling Agent Skills, and identify two complementary failures of existing paradigms: metadata-level context pollution under progressive disclosure and capability misalignment or unnecessary Skill exposure under static retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将选择性技能暴露定义为扩展智能体技能的核心问题，并指出了现有范式的两种互补性缺陷：在渐进式披露下出现的元数据层上下文污染，以及在静态检索下出现的能力不匹配或不必要的技能暴露。

paragraphs.en: We propose SkillBrowser , a Meta-Skill-managed framework that allows agents to decide whether external Skills are needed, formulate structured capability-oriented queries and load retrieved Skill contents on demand during problem solving.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SkillBrowser，这是一个由元技能管理的框架，它允许智能体在解决问题时决定是否需要外部技能，构建结构化的能力导向查询，并根据需求加载检索到的技能内容。

paragraphs.en: We develop SkillGrep , a capability-oriented Skill search system that expands Skill metadata into multiple retrieval views and applies hybrid retrieval to align agent-formulated needs with relevant Skills.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了 SkillGrep，一个以能力为导向的技能搜索系统。该系统将技能元数据扩展为多种检索视图，并采用混合检索方法，使智能体提出的需求与相关技能相匹配。

paragraphs.en: We conduct experiments on SRA-Bench ( Su et al., 2026 ) , showing improved end-task performance over static retrieval and substantially reduced degradation from unnecessary Skill exposure on already-solvable instances.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 SRA-Bench（Su 等人，2026）上进行了实验，结果表明，与静态检索方法相比，本方法在最终任务上的性能有所提升，并且对于已经可解决的实例，不必要的技能暴露所导致的性能下降也显著减少。

paragraphs.en: Early tool-augmented agents extend LLMs with external callable capabilities: ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) establishes the reasoning-and-acting paradigm, while API-Bank, ToolLLM, and Gorilla ( Li et al., 2023 ; Qin et al., 2024 ; Patil et al., 2024 ; Patel et al., 2026 ) study API use and selection over increasingly large tool collections. Recent Agent Skills broaden this abstraction to reusable capability packages containing procedural instructions and optional resources such as scripts, templates, examples, or references ( Xu and Yan, 2026 ) . Unlike callable tools, Skills are loaded as procedural context for subsequent reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的工具增强型智能体通过外部可调用能力扩展了大型语言模型：ReAct（Yao 等人，2023）确立了推理与行动范式，而 API-Bank、ToolLLM 和 Gorilla（Li 等人，2023；Qin 等人，2024；Patil 等人，2024；Patel 等人，2026）则研究了在日益庞大的工具集合中如何使用和选择 API。 近期的智能体技能将这种抽象概念扩展到了可重复使用的能力包，这些能力包包含过程性指令以及可选资源，例如脚本、模板、示例或参考材料（Xu 和 Yan，2026）。 与可调用工具不同，技能是以过程性上下文的形式加载，用于后续的推理。

paragraphs.en: To access Skills efficiently, recent systems commonly adopt progressive disclosure, exposing compact metadata before loading detailed Skill contents on demand ( Xu and Yan, 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) . Although this avoids preloading full Skill documents, the exposed metadata catalog still grows with the repository and may hinder reliable Skill selection at scale ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . This limitation motivates retrieving a compact candidate set rather than exposing the full Skill catalog; however, as discussed next, retrieval alone does not determine whether the returned procedural contents should enter the agent’s reasoning context.
paragraphs.zh: 为了高效访问技能，近期系统通常采用渐进式披露方法，即先展示简洁的元数据，再按需加载详细的技能内容（Xu and Yan, 2026；Jiang et al., 2026）。 尽管这种方法避免了预加载完整的技能文档，但所披露的元数据目录仍会随着知识库的扩展而增长，并可能在大规模场景下阻碍可靠的技能选择（Zheng et al., 2026）。 这一局限性促使系统转而检索一个精简的候选集，而非展示完整的技能目录；然而，如下文所述，仅靠检索本身并不能决定返回的流程性内容是否应被纳入智能体的推理上下文。

sents.en: To access Skills efficiently, recent systems commonly adopt progressive disclosure, exposing compact metadata before loading detailed Skill contents on demand ( Xu and Yan, 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 为了高效访问技能，近期系统通常采用渐进式披露方法，即先展示简洁的元数据，再按需加载详细的技能内容（Xu and Yan, 2026；Jiang et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Although this avoids preloading full Skill documents, the exposed metadata catalog still grows with the repository and may hinder reliable Skill selection at scale ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 尽管这种方法避免了预加载完整的技能文档，但所披露的元数据目录仍会随着知识库的扩展而增长，并可能在大规模场景下阻碍可靠的技能选择（Zheng et al., 2026）。

sents.en: This limitation motivates retrieving a compact candidate set rather than exposing the full Skill catalog; however, as discussed next, retrieval alone does not determine whether the returned procedural contents should enter the agent’s reasoning context.
sents.zh: 这一局限性促使系统转而检索一个精简的候选集，而非展示完整的技能目录；然而，如下文所述，仅靠检索本身并不能决定返回的流程性内容是否应被纳入智能体的推理上下文。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval provides an alternative to global capability exposure. Prior work investigates dedicated tool retrieval, feedback-enhanced retrieval, and generation-based tool selection over large tool inventories ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ; Fei et al., 2025 ) . ToolReAGt further performs iterative retrieval of callable tools for decomposed complex requests ( Braunschweiler et al., 2025 ) . These methods are related to our work in external capability access, but focus on executable tool interfaces rather than procedural Skill contents injected into the model context.
paragraphs.zh: 检索为全局能力暴露提供了一种替代方案。 先前的研究探讨了针对大型工具库的专用工具检索、反馈增强型检索以及基于生成的工具选择方法（Xu et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025；Shi et al., 2025；Fei et al., 2025）。 ToolReAGt 进一步对分解后的复杂请求执行可调用工具的迭代检索（Braunschweiler et al., 2025）。 这些方法与我们在外部能力访问方面的研究相关，但它们的重点是可执行的工具接口，而非注入模型上下文的过程性技能内容。

paragraphs.en: In the Skill setting, SRA retrieves Skills from a large external corpus and evaluates both retrieval quality and downstream Skill use ( Su et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , while SkillRouter studies large-scale Skill routing with richer Skill representations ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . We study a complementary problem: static retrieval may fail to match capability needs that emerge during reasoning, and retrieved Skill contents need not always be exposed to the agent. SkillBrowser addresses this problem through Meta-Skill-managed access, allowing agents to formulate capability-oriented queries and load selected Skills on demand.
paragraphs.zh: 在技能设置中，SRA 从大型外部语料库中检索技能，并评估检索质量以及下游技能的运用（Su et al., 2026；Liu et al., 2026），而 SkillRouter 则研究具有更丰富技能表示的大规模技能路由（Zheng et al., 2026）。 我们研究一个互补性问题：静态检索可能无法匹配推理过程中出现的能力需求，且检索到的技能内容也未必需要始终向智能体暴露。 SkillBrowser 通过元技能管理的访问机制解决这一问题，使智能体能够构建以能力为导向的查询，并按需加载选定的技能。

paragraphs.en: Beyond selecting which external capability is relevant, a complementary line of work studies whether external assistance should be used at all. In tool-augmented agents, When2Call explicitly evaluates decisions to invoke a tool, request clarification, or refrain from tool use, while When2Tool studies tool necessity under controlled capability boundaries and shows that agents frequently invoke tools even when their parametric capabilities suffice ( Ross et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . Moving from tool invocation to retrieval, ProactAgent treats access to factual, episodic, and behavioral-skill experience as an explicit policy action and learns when and what to retrieve through process-level reinforcement learning ( Cai et al., 2026 ) . These works establish that capability access itself can be treated as a decision rather than mandatory.
paragraphs.zh: 除了选择哪项外部能力相关之外，另一项互补的研究则探讨是否应当使用外部协助。 在工具增强型智能体中，When2Call 明确评估调用工具、请求澄清或不使用工具的决策，而 When2Tool 则在受控的能力边界下研究工具的必要性，并表明即使参数化能力已足够，智能体也常常会调用工具（Ross et al., 2025；Sun et al., 2026）。 从工具调用转向信息检索，ProactAgent 将获取事实性、事件性和行为技能经验视为一项显式的策略动作，并通过过程级强化学习来学习何时以及检索哪些内容（Cai et al., 2026）。 这些研究确立了这样一个观点：能力访问本身可以被视为一项决策，而非强制性操作。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has begun to study this question specifically for Agent Skills. SelSkill formulates Skill use as a decision-point-level skill-or-skip problem and learns selective invocation through dual-granularity preference learning ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . SkillApt instead separates retrieval from activation: after a candidate Skill has already been retrieved, it uses counterfactual evidence from matched executions to decide whether the Skill should actually be loaded ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . SkillGate trains in-policy, mid-episode Skill selection with action-local credit assignment over a visible candidate slate, reducing exposure to misleading Skills, although its selection-specific objective does not directly assign credit to abstention ( Li et al., 2026a ) . SkillBrowser differs in both the decision point and the mechanism: we study pre-retrieval Skill necessity , allowing an agent to bypass Skill search entirely when external procedural guidance is unnecessary, while jointly formulating a capability-oriented query when search is warranted. Moreover, unlike learned invocation or activation policies, this control is realized through a training-free Meta-Skill and can be combined with different underlying Skill retrieval methods.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究开始专门针对智能体技能（Agent Skills）这一问题展开探讨。 SelSkill 将技能使用建模为决策点层面的“使用或跳过”问题，并通过双粒度偏好学习来掌握选择性调用（Chen et al., 2026）。 SkillApt 则将检索与激活分离：在候选技能已被检索出来后，它利用匹配执行过程中的反事实证据来决定该技能是否应被实际加载（Guo et al., 2026）。 SkillGate 在策略内、中期阶段对可见的候选技能列表进行技能选择训练，并通过动作局部信用分配来减少接触误导性技能的机会，尽管其专门针对选择的优化目标并未直接为“不调用”分配信用（Li et al., 2026a）。 SkillBrowser 在决策点和机制上均有所不同：我们研究的是检索前的技能必要性，使得智能体在无需外部流程指导时能够完全跳过技能搜索，而在搜索必要时则同步构建一个以能力为导向的查询。 此外，与通过训练获得的调用或激活策略不同，这种控制是通过无需训练的元技能（Meta-Skill）实现的，并且可以与不同的底层技能检索方法相结合。

paragraphs.en: Accessing a large Skill library requires deciding which Skills should enter the agent’s working context. Existing paradigms make this decision imperfectly: progressive disclosure exposes metadata for a growing candidate catalog, while static retrieval exposes a small set of Skill contents selected from the initial task query. We formulate the resulting problem as Selective Skill Exposure : a scalable Skill access mechanism should expose only the information necessary for the agent’s current solving need, avoiding both irrelevant metadata and unnecessary procedural contents.
paragraphs.zh: 访问大型技能库需要决定哪些技能应进入智能体的工作语境。 现有范式对此类决策的处理并不完善：渐进式披露会暴露越来越多候选技能的元数据，而静态检索则会从初始任务查询中选取少量技能内容并予以展示。 我们将由此产生的问题定义为“选择性技能披露”：一种可扩展的技能访问机制应仅揭示智能体当前解决任务所需的信息，同时避免无关的元数据和多余的过程性内容。

paragraphs.en: As the Skill repository grows, progressive disclosure requires the agent to identify the needed capability from an increasingly large metadata catalog. We examine whether this growing metadata exposure impairs reliable Skill access.
paragraphs.zh: 随着技能库的不断扩展，渐进式披露要求智能体从日益庞大的元数据目录中识别出所需的能力。 我们研究了这种不断增长的元数据暴露是否会影响技能的可靠访问。

paragraphs.en: Together, these observations show that scalable Skill access requires controlling how Skill contents enter the agent’s context. Progressive disclosure forces the agent to select Skills from an increasingly polluted metadata context, while static retrieval may preselect Skills from an initial query that does not reflect the capability need emerging during solving. Furthermore, retrieved Skill contents should not be injected unconditionally when external support is unnecessary. We therefore formulate Selective Skill Exposure : Skill contents should be introduced according to the agent’s current capability need, rather than through global metadata exposure or one-shot query-based retrieval. We instantiate this principle with SkillBrowser in the next section.
paragraphs.zh: 这些观察结果共同表明，可扩展的技能访问需要控制技能内容进入智能体上下文的方式。 渐进式披露迫使智能体从日益混杂的元数据上下文中选择技能，而静态检索则可能根据初始查询预先选择技能，该查询无法反映问题解决过程中出现的能力需求。 此外，当外部支持并非必要时，不应无条件地注入检索到的技能内容。 因此，我们提出了选择性技能暴露原则：技能内容应根据智能体的当前能力需求引入，而不是通过全局元数据暴露或单次查询式检索引入。 我们将在下一节中通过 SkillBrowser 具体实现这一原则。

paragraphs.en: Online, SkillGrep matches the agent-generated query against these representations using hybrid retrieval. It combines lexical matching, which captures precise terms and identifiers, with semantic matching, which captures paraphrased capability needs, and fuses the resulting rankings to return the top- k k Skills. paragraphs.en: We report end-task accuracy as the primary metric. For Selective Skill Exposure, we additionally analyze two subsets constructed separately for each model–benchmark pair: skill-beneficial instances, which are solved incorrectly without Skills but correctly with the gold Skill, and skill-unnecessary instances, which are solved correctly under both conditions. We report Beneficial Exposure Rate (BER) on the former and Unnecessary Exposure Rate (UER) on the latter, each defined as the fraction of instances receiving retrieved Skill contents. These are outcome-conditioned, model-dependent diagnostic partitions, not intrinsic labels of Skill necessity; they omit instances incorrect under both conditions and those harmed by gold exposure. BER measures exposure to any retrieved Skill, not successful gold-Skill retrieval. We additionally report retrieval quality, end-to-end resource use, and paired correctness comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将任务最终准确率作为主要指标进行报告。 对于选择性技能暴露，我们还分析了为每个模型-基准组合分别构建的两个子集：技能有益实例（即在没有使用技能时解答错误，但使用黄金技能后能正确解答的实例）和技能非必要实例（即在这两种条件下都能正确解答的实例）。 我们对前者报告有益暴露率（BER），对后者报告非必要暴露率（UER），两者均定义为获得检索到的技能内容的实例比例。 这些是受结果条件和模型影响的诊断性划分，而非技能必要性的内在标签；它们忽略了在两种条件下都解答错误的实例以及因暴露于黄金技能而表现受损的实例。 BER衡量的是对任何检索到的技能的暴露程度，而非成功检索到黄金技能的情况。 我们还报告了检索质量、端到端的资源使用以及成对的正确性比较。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 compares Meta-Skill-managed access with Static SkillGrep under the same retrieval backend. Static SkillGrep exposes retrieved Skill contents for every query, whereas Meta-Skill-managed access allows the agent to decide whether external procedural support should enter its reasoning context. This comparison controls for retrieval-backend strength; its effect jointly reflects the decision to search and the capability-oriented queries generated when searching.

paragraphs.en: On skill-unnecessary instances, Meta-Skill-managed access reduces exposure and improves accuracy for every model after aggregation across the four diagnostic benchmarks. Since these instances are already solvable without external Skills, the result shows that even retrieved procedural contents can disturb otherwise correct reasoning when introduced unconditionally. This finding directly supports SSE: Skill access requires controlling not only which Skills are retrieved, but also whether their contents should be exposed to the agent at all.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we formulate Selective Skill Exposure as a central problem for scaling Skill-using LLM agents: procedural support should be introduced according to the agent’s current need, without exposing excessive metadata or unnecessary Skill contents. We show that existing paradigms fall short in complementary ways. Progressive disclosure remains vulnerable to metadata-level context pollution, while static retrieval may expose Skills selected from an initial query misaligned with the capability needed during reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们将选择性技能暴露定义为扩展技能使用型 LLM 智能体的核心问题：应根据智能体的当前需求引入程序化支持，同时避免暴露过多的元数据或不必要的技能内容。 我们发现现有范式在互补性方面均存在不足。 渐进式披露仍易受到元数据层级的上下文污染，而静态检索则可能暴露与推理过程中所需能力不匹配的、基于初始查询选择的技能。

paragraphs.en: We propose SkillBrowser , a Meta-Skill-managed framework for SSE. Rather than selecting Skills from a globally exposed catalog or unconditionally injecting retrieved contents, it makes Skill exposure an agent-initiated action: when procedural support is needed, the agent formulates a capability-oriented query through the Meta-Skill and retrieves relevant Skills from SkillGrep for on-demand use.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SkillBrowser，一个由元技能管理的 SSE 框架。 与从全局公开的目录中选择技能或无条件注入检索到的内容不同，它将技能的暴露变为智能体主动发起的行为：当需要流程支持时，智能体通过元技能构建一个以能力为导向的查询，并从 SkillGrep 中检索相关技能以供按需使用。

paragraphs.en: Experiments on SRA-Bench show that metadata exposure impairs Skill loading at scale, while SkillBrowser improves end-task accuracy over static query-based retrieval, especially when the required procedure is obscured by noisy context. Meta-Skill-managed access further mitigates the degradation caused by unnecessary Skill exposure on already-solvable instances. The added ToolQA evaluation extends this evidence to multi-step tool interaction, while comparisons with LLM Selection support aggregate gains over a stronger deployable baseline. Under-invocation, task-dependent losses, and additional latency remain limitations of the approach.
paragraphs.zh: 在 SRA-Bench 上的实验表明，元数据暴露会损害大规模的技能加载，而 SkillBrowser 相比基于静态查询的检索方法能提升最终任务的准确率，尤其是在所需流程被噪声上下文掩盖的情况下。 由元技能管理的访问机制进一步减轻了不必要的技能暴露对已可解决实例造成的性能下降。 新增的 ToolQA 评估将这一证据扩展到了多步骤工具交互场景，而与 LLM Selection 的比较则支持了相比更强大的可部署基线模型所实现的累积增益。 调用不足、任务相关的损失以及额外的延迟仍然是该方法的局限性。

paragraphs.en: SkillBrowser depends on imperfect capability-need recognition. Models may under-invoke useful Skills on problems resembling ordinary internal reasoning, especially LogicBench and CHAMP. The beneficial/unnecessary partitions are model- and outcome-dependent diagnostics, not intrinsic necessity labels. They omit two reference-outcome groups and do not capture variability across repeated runs. Improving need recognition through targeted training, preference optimization, or uncertainty modeling is future work.

paragraphs.en: Our six-subset evaluation includes multi-step ToolQA interactions but uses a fixed repository. paragraphs.en: Retrieval adds latency, and token savings depend on the task. The LLM Selection timing excludes precomputed BM25 retrieval, so reported latency is not a fully symmetric online-system comparison. Pooled significance tests do not establish gains for every model or dataset; repeated task instances across backbones can also induce dependence among pooled observations. Broader sensitivity studies of k k , encoder choice, and abstention thresholds remain open.
paragraphs.zh: 检索会增加延迟，而标记数量的节省则取决于具体任务。 LLM 选择的时机未包含预计算的 BM25 检索，因此所报告的延迟并非完全对称的在线系统对比结果。 合并显著性检验并不能证明所有模型或数据集都能获得增益；不同基础模型中重复的任务实例也可能导致合并后的观测值之间产生依赖关系。 关于 k、编码器选择以及弃权阈值的更广泛敏感性研究仍有待开展。

paragraphs.en: Real repositories may contain erroneous, incomplete, or unsafe instructions. SSE addresses when and which Skills enter context; it does not verify their trustworthiness or guarantee safe execution. Provenance review at ingestion, content validation before loading, permission checks before tool use, and execution sandboxing are possible deployment safeguards, none of which is established by the present evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 真实存储库可能包含错误、不完整或不安全的指令。 SSE 会处理技能何时以及哪些技能进入上下文的问题，但它不会验证这些技能的可靠性，也不会保证它们的安全执行。 在数据摄入时进行来源审查、在加载前进行内容验证、在使用工具前检查权限以及在执行时设置沙盒，都是可能的部署安全措施，但本次评估并未确立其中任何一种措施。

paragraphs.en: SRA-Bench formulates each evaluation instance as a user query paired with one or more annotated gold skills. Each skill is a reusable capability artifact, including task-solving instructions, mathematical procedures, logical inference patterns, clinical calculation rules, or software-library usage guidance. Importantly, agents do not retrieve from a small task-specific library: the benchmark mixes gold skills with web-collected distractor skills, yielding a shared retrieval corpus of 26,262 candidate skills. This setting evaluates whether an agent can identify the capability needed for solving a task under a realistically noisy skill library.
paragraphs.zh: SRA-Bench 将每个评估实例构成为一条用户查询，并配有一个或多个经过标注的黄金技能。 每种技能都是一种可重复使用的能力组件，包括任务解决指令、数学步骤、逻辑推理模式、临床计算规则或软件库使用指南。 重要的是，智能体并不会从某个小型的任务专用库中检索：该基准测试将黄金技能与从网络收集到的干扰性技能混合在一起，从而形成一个包含 26,262 个候选技能的共享检索语料库。 这种设置旨在评估智能体是否能够在真实存在噪声的技能库中识别出完成任务所需的能力。

paragraphs.en: TheoremQA evaluates the retrieval and application of reusable mathematical and scientific principles. Its questions span domains such as combinatorics, calculus, linear algebra, physics, probability, economics, and graph theory. Each instance is paired with a single gold skill describing the theorem, formula, or canonical procedure needed to solve the question. For example, an instance asking for the number of ways to divide a set of eight elements into five non-empty ordered subsets is paired with the skill Lah Numbers . This subset therefore measures whether the agent can retrieve an appropriate abstract principle rather than relying only on surface-level lexical overlap.
paragraphs.zh: TheoremQA 评估可重复使用的数学和科学原理的检索与应用能力。 其问题涵盖组合学、微积分、线性代数、物理学、概率论、经济学和图论等多个领域。 每个实例都配有一个唯一的标准技能，用于描述解决该问题所需的定理、公式或标准步骤。 例如，一个询问将八个元素集合划分为五个非空有序子集的方法数的问题，会搭配“拉赫数”这一技能。 因此，这一子集用于衡量智能体是否能够检索出合适的抽象原理，而不仅仅是依赖表层词汇的匹配。

paragraphs.en: LogicBench evaluates retrieval for deductive reasoning tasks. Each instance contains a collection of premises and several candidate conclusions, and the model must identify which conclusion logically follows from the premises. The associated skills represent reusable logical reasoning patterns rather than domain-specific facts. Since the benchmark uses single-skill annotations and rule-based answer checking, it provides a controlled setting for testing whether retrieved reasoning procedures can support symbolic inference.
paragraphs.zh: LogicBench 评估演绎推理任务中的信息检索能力。 每个实例包含一组前提和若干候选结论，模型必须确定哪个结论能从前提中逻辑推导出来。 相关的技能代表可重用的逻辑推理模式，而非特定领域的知识。 由于该基准测试使用单一技能标注和基于规则的答案验证，因此为测试检索到的推理流程能否支持符号推理提供了一个受控环境。

paragraphs.en: CHAMP contains mathematical problem-solving instances that require applying one or more mathematical concepts or procedures. Compared with TheoremQA , which is annotated with a single theorem-oriented skill, CHAMP is configured as a multi-skill benchmark in SRA-Bench. Its problems include combinatorial counting and other structured mathematical reasoning tasks. Consequently, this subset evaluates whether a retrieval method can recover multiple complementary skills when solving a single query requires composing several procedures.
paragraphs.zh: CHAMP 包含需要应用一个或多个数学概念或步骤的数学问题求解实例。 与 TheoremQA（仅标注单一以定理为导向的技能）相比，CHAMP 在 SRA-Bench 中被配置为多技能基准测试。 其问题包括组合计数和其他结构化的数学推理任务。 因此，该子集用于评估检索方法在解决单个查询时需要组合多个步骤时，能否恢复多种互补的技能。

paragraphs.en: MedCalcBench evaluates retrieval of clinical calculation procedures. Each query describes patient attributes such as age, sex, laboratory measurements, or body weight, and asks for the result of a named or implied medical calculator. For example, a released instance requests estimated creatinine clearance for a 68-year-old female patient using the Cockcroft–Gault equation. The benchmark is especially relevant for skill retrieval because correct task execution depends on identifying the appropriate calculator, grounding its required variables, and applying the formula consistently. We use this benchmark only as a procedural calculation task and do not interpret model outputs as medical advice.
paragraphs.zh: MedCalcBench 评估临床计算流程的检索能力。 每个查询都会描述患者的属性，例如年龄、性别、实验室测量值或体重，并要求返回某个明确命名或隐含的医学计算器得出的结果。 例如，一个已发布的实例要求使用 Cockcroft–Gault 方程估算一名 68 岁女性患者的肌酐清除率。 该基准测试对于技能检索尤为重要，因为正确执行任务需要识别合适的计算器、确定其所需变量，并一致地应用公式。 我们仅将此基准测试用作流程性计算任务，并不将模型输出解释为医疗建议。

paragraphs.en: BigCodeBench evaluates retrieval of software-library usage skills. Unlike the other selected subsets, its evaluation is execution-based: a generated solution is checked by running the associated tests rather than by comparing a normalized textual answer. SRA-Bench models this subset as multi-skill retrieval, reflecting the fact that a programming task may require combining several API or library capabilities. This benchmark therefore tests whether retrieved skills can support executable task completion, complementing the rule-based reasoning benchmarks above.
paragraphs.zh: BigCodeBench 评估对软件库使用技能的检索能力。 与其他选定的子集不同，其评估基于执行：生成的解决方案通过运行相关测试来验证，而不是通过比较标准化后的文本答案。 SRA-Bench 将该子集建模为多技能检索，反映了编程任务可能需要结合多种 API 或库功能这一事实。 因此，该基准测试检验了检索到的技能是否支持可执行的任务完成，从而补充了上述基于规则的推理基准测试。

paragraphs.en: We provide the complete model–benchmark level results for the Selective Skill Exposure analysis. For each model–benchmark pair, we construct two subsets according to the outcomes under the no-Skill and gold-Skill reference conditions. An instance is skill-beneficial if the model answers incorrectly without external Skills but correctly when provided with the annotated gold Skill. An instance is skill-unnecessary if the model answers correctly under both conditions. This partition is constructed separately for each model–benchmark pair because the utility of external procedural support depends on the backbone model’s native capability.

paragraphs.en: We compare Meta-Skill , which denotes Meta-Skill-managed Skill access, with SkillGrep , which statically retrieves Skills through the same hybrid retrieval backend. On skill-beneficial instances, we report Beneficial Exposure Rate (BER), i.e., the percentage of instances on which retrieved Skill contents are exposed, together with downstream accuracy. On skill-unnecessary instances, we report Unnecessary Exposure Rate (UER), where lower values indicate less unnecessary procedural exposure.

paragraphs.en: Tables 7 and 8 provide a fine-grained view of how Meta-Skill-managed access affects Skill exposure. On skill-unnecessary instances, the advantage is highly consistent: Meta-Skill-managed access lowers unnecessary exposure relative to static SkillGrep retrieval in 19 of 20 model–benchmark pairs (with one tie), and improves downstream accuracy in 18 out of 20 pairs. Micro-aggregated across all settings, it reduces UER from 100.0 % 100.0\% to 70.9 % 70.9\% while improving accuracy from 93.2 % 93.2\% to 97.9 % 97.9\% . These results support the central motivation of Selective Skill Exposure: blindly injecting retrieved procedural contents can disrupt tasks already solvable without external assistance.
paragraphs.zh: 表 7 和表 8 详细展示了由 Meta-Skill 管理的访问权限如何影响技能的暴露程度。 在无需使用技能的情况下，其优势高度一致：在 20 个模型-基准组合中，有 19 个（以及一个平局）显示，与静态的 SkillGrep 检索相比，由 Meta-Skill 管理的访问权限减少了不必要的暴露，并在 20 个组合中的 18 个组合中提升了下游任务的准确率。 在所有设置中进行微聚合后，该方法将 UER 从 100.0 % 100.0\% 降低至 70.9 % 70.9\%，同时将准确率从 93.2 % 93.2\% 提升至 97.9 % 97.9\%。 这些结果支持了“选择性技能暴露”的核心理念：盲目注入检索到的程序性内容，可能会干扰那些原本无需外部帮助即可解决的任务。

paragraphs.en: On skill-beneficial instances, Meta-Skill-managed access exhibits a more task- and model-dependent pattern. It achieves strong gains on several MedCalcBench and TheoremQA settings, including improvements of 15.2 15.2 points on GLM-5.1/ MedCalcBench and 11.9 11.9 points on GLM-5.1/ TheoremQA . These results indicate that capability-oriented access can improve the utility of exposed Skills when the agent successfully articulates its need. However, substantial drops on GPT-5.4-mini and Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite for LogicBench and CHAMP show that some agents do not reliably invoke Skill access when external support would be beneficial. Overall, Meta-Skill management provides a robust mechanism for avoiding unnecessary Skill exposure, while improving the recognition of beneficial Skill use remains an important direction for future work.

Combined token use is lower than LLM Selection on TheoremQA, MedCalcBench, and BigCodeBench, and higher on LogicBench, CHAMP, and ToolQA. Latency is higher on all six benchmarks. SkillBrowser’s online path includes query generation, retrieval, and Skill loading; Gold Exposure directly loads the annotated Skill, whereas LLM Selection starts from a precomputed BM25 top-50 set and excludes BM25 retrieval from its reported latency. These measurements characterize the evaluated configurations rather than equal-stage online latency. Input/output tokens provide a pricing-independent resource proxy, but not a universal monetary-cost estimate.

paragraphs.en: Among Gold-incorrect/SkillBrowser-correct instances, the reported search and gold-exposure rates are 60.1 % 60.1\% and 51.6 % 51.6\% , respectively. paragraphs.en: The pooled analysis treats model–instance pairs as observations. Repeated tasks across backbones may violate independence, so the nominal pooled p p -values should not be interpreted as a hierarchical or cluster-adjusted analysis. Nor do they establish significance for every model–dataset setting. Per-setting sample counts and correctness outcomes are needed for 95% Wilson accuracy intervals and stratified tests; the reported rounded accuracies alone do not determine those intervals.
paragraphs.zh: 合并分析将模型-实例对视为观察数据。 不同基础模型中重复的任务可能违反独立性假设，因此名义上的合并 p 值不应被解释为分层或聚类调整后的分析结果。 这些结果也无法证明所有模型-数据集组合都具有显著性。 要计算 95% Wilson 准确率置信区间和分层检验，需要每个设置下的样本量和正确性结果；仅凭所报告的取整准确率无法确定这些置信区间。
